basis: Rates from the Utah 2024 bill. Hours per source TB measured with overlapped downloads: 60 cm 3.9 (Rhode Island 2025) and 4.1 (New Hampshire 2025); 30 cm 4.9 (Vermont 2025 sample, 20 quads, with the pixel check counted at one quad in 50). 2 GiB tasks for 60 cm, 4 GiB for 30 cm (measured peak 1.5 GiB). Request counts measured on Rhode Island and Vermont. The high case uses Utah-like speed for 60 cm and 20% slower 30 cm.
not_included: Storage of the output, about 21 TB (18 to 24). In a bucket of ours that is about $415 to $555 a month at $0.023 per GB.
